items.title: Google Open-Sources AX a Kubernetes Style Orchestrator for Autonomous AI Agents
items.blurb: Google has open-sourced AX, an orchestrator designed for managing autonomous AI agent workloads. AX operates on a runtime, Agent Substrate, treating agents as stateful actors.

items.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Tracking When a PersistentVolumeClaim Was Last Used (Beta)
items.blurb: Kubernetes v1.37 promotes the PersistentVolumeClaimUnusedSinceTime feature gate to Beta (enabled by default).
